newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Yukong's CDU full operation seen delayed.
newsitem.headline: Yukong's CDU full operation seen delayed.

text.p: Yukong Ltd, South Korea's biggest oil refiner, said on Monday it sees full production of its new 200,000 barrels per day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) delayed until Sunday.
Yukong had expected full commercial operation by Tuesday.

"The maintenance work on several cracks at the topper's pipeline welding joints has slowed us down," a Yukong official told Reuters. "But the unit is now working properly and have yielded some oil products."
Yukong started feeding crude oil to the unit early last month, he said.
The new CDU will raise Yukong's total refining capacity to 810,000 bpd from 610,000 bpd.
